scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build

scripts.build:crazy: VITE_PORTAL_TARGET=crazy VITE_MULTIPLAYER_URL= vite build --outDir dist-crazy && node scripts/package-portal.mjs crazy
